dedupe_keys.name: system level cyclic loading responses of composite steel gravity framing

description: System-level cyclic loading responses of composite steel gravity framing is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Todd Helwig, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). This research investigated experimentally the seismic performance of steel gravity framing with a concrete slab at the system level. Two half-story, two-by-three bay steel gravity frame specimens were tested under cyclic loading. Bolted-bolted double-angle connections were used for a beam-to-column gravity connection. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Composite steel gravity framing, system level, seismic performance, cyclic loading. Published 2023-05-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
